text: dsh-plugin-session-clock 是一个面向 DSH 网页端的会话时间显示插件。它注册一个不可见的 shell.overlay 界面座位，读取会话更新时间，并改写左侧会话行中的相对时间。它将今天的时间显示为时分，昨天显示为带“昨天”的时分，同一年更早的日期显示为月日，往年日期显示为两位年份、月日；未来时间按今天显示，并每 30 秒刷新。适合希望快速从侧栏辨认会话更新时间的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-session-clock changes relative sidebar times to local dates. Its shell.overlay seat reads update times and rewrites rows: today shows hour and minute, yesterday gets a localized label, and older dates show month/day or a two-digit year. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 左侧会话列表显示具体日期和时间。
能把“3小时前”之类的会话时间改成时钟格式吗？

让侧栏里的昨天会话带上昨天和更新时间。

DSH 会话列表的时间不够直观，怎么查看更新时间？
Show exact clock times for sessions in the DSH sidebar.
Can the session list use calendar dates instead of relative times?
dsh-plugin-session-clock 的功能「绝对时间标签」：把侧栏会话行的相对更新时间替换为本地时分、昨天时分、月日或两位年份日期；未来时间按今天显示。页面变化时重绘，并定时刷新。
dsh-plugin-session-clock 的功能「按会话更新时间显示」：从 DSH 会话快照读取每个会话的 updatedAt，并仅处理带 session 行标识的会话列表项，依据时间生成绝对日期标签。
dsh-plugin-session-clock 的功能「保留状态文字」：只改写已知的中英文相对时间或插件自己上次写入的文字；遇到“进行中”等其他状态文字时保留原内容。
dsh-plugin-session-clock 依赖会话行的 data-row-key 标记和第三个子元素作为时间格；内核调整行结构后，标签可能静默退回相对时间。
dsh-plugin-session-clock README · dsh-plugin-session-clock：把左侧栏会话列表里的相对时间（`刚刚`、`3小时`、`1天`、`2个月`）改成微信式的绝对时间。

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · 效果：| 时间 | 显示 |
|---|---|
| 今天 | `21:12`（24 小时制，补零） |
| 昨天 | `昨天21:12` |
| 今年更早 | `10/27` |
| 往年 | `25/12/31`（两位年份） |

未来时间（时钟偏差）按今天处理，只显示 `HH:MM`。英文界面下「昨天」显示 `Yesterday `，并且同样接管内核原本的 `now` / `5min` / `3h` / `1d` / `2mo` / `2y`。

格式跟随时区与系统时钟；跨过零点后每 30 秒自动刷新一次，所以 `21:12` 会在午夜变成 `10/29`。

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · 为什么是 DOM 补丁：这段文案由内核包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 的 `timeLabel()` 直接渲染，侧栏没有提供替换该文本的插槽：`sidebar.workspaces` 是单值插槽，替换它等于接管整个会话浏览器（搜索、分组、拖拽、重命名都要重写）。所以本插件走最小侵入路径：

- 注册一个不可见的 `shell.overlay` 座位（只返回 `null`），拿到标准 `useSessions` 快照里的 `updatedAt`
- 用 `MutationObserver` 跟随内核已经发布的 `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]` 行，只改写第三列时间文本
- 只处理两类文本：内核刚写下的相对标签，或本插件自己上一次写的文本；单元格里出现「进行中」这类状态文案时一律不动
- 改写时直接改文本节点的 `nodeValue`，保留 React 持有的那个节点，避免下次重渲染写进已脱离文档的节点
- 观察器把连续变更合并成每 100ms 至多一次重绘，流式回答时不会按帧空转
section: 为什么是 DOM 补丁

text: dsh-plugin-session-clock README · 为什么是 DOM 补丁：**代价与失效表现**：这是 DOM 级补丁，不是插槽级扩展。如果内核改掉 `data-row-key` 属性、或调整行的子元素顺序，插件会静默失效——列表退回相对时间，不报错、也不弄坏列表。升级 DSH 后请看一眼列表时间是否还是绝对格式。
section: 为什么是 DOM 补丁

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · dsh-plugin-session-clock：Rewrites the relative times in the sidebar's session list (`刚刚`, `3小时`, `1天`, `2个月`) as WeChat-style absolute times.

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · What you get：| When | Label |
|---|---|
| Today | `21:12` (24-hour, zero-padded) |
| Yesterday | `昨天21:12` |
| Earlier this year | `10/27` |
| Earlier years | `25/12/31` (two-digit year) |

A timestamp in the future (clock skew) reads as today's clock, `HH:MM`. In the English UI the yesterday word is `Yesterday `, and the shipped `now` / `5min` / `3h` / `1d` / `2mo` / `2y` labels are taken over as well.
dsh-plugin-session-clock README · What you get：Labels follow the system clock and time zone and refresh every 30 seconds, so a `21:12` becomes `10/29` after midnight.

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Why this is a DOM patch：The label is rendered directly by the kernel package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` through `timeLabel()`, and the sidebar offers no slot that replaces that text: `sidebar.workspaces` is a single-value slot, so taking it over means reimplementing the whole session browser (search, grouping, drag, rename). This plugin therefore takes the smallest invasive path:
section: Why this is a DOM patch

text:
dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Why this is a DOM patch：- registers an invisible `shell.overlay` seat (returns `null`) to read `updatedAt` from the standard `useSessions` snapshot
- follows the row keys the kernel already publishes — `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]` — and rewrites only the third column's text
- touches only two kinds of text: a shipped relative label, or this plugin's own previous write; transient status text such as "进行中" is never touched
- writes `nodeValue` on the existing text node, keeping the node React holds, so the next rerender does not write into a detached node
- coalesces mutation bursts into at most one repaint per 100 ms, so a streaming answer does not spin the observer every frame
section: Why this is a DOM patch

text: dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Why this is a DOM patch：**Cost and failure mode**: this is a DOM-level patch, not a slot-level extension. If the kernel renames `data-row-key` or reorders a row's children, the plugin silently stops working — the list falls back to relative times, with no error and no damage. After upgrading DSH, glance at the list to confirm the labels are still absolute.
section: Why this is a DOM patch

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Compatibility：Developed and used against **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3** (macOS desktop profile). The row structure was checked against that version's `SessionRow`: the third child is the time cell, and the row carries `data-row-key="session:<id>"`. Earlier versions were not checked one by one; per the failure mode above, a structural mismatch only falls back to relative times.

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Development：```
node test/smoke.mjs
```

A headless smoke test runs the real `lib/client.js` against a fake module loader, a fake Cordis context, and a synthetic session row. It covers all four `clockLabel` branches, Chinese and English relative labels plus the guard against false positives, protection of status text, repainting an already painted row, and the slot registration. React comes from `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` (override with `DSH_PROFILE_MODULES`).

dsh-plugin-session-clock README · Known limits：- Session rows only; the hover card's "创建于 …" and its relative time are untouched
- Left sidebar session rows only; search-result metadata carries no time
- Date order is not localized: `MM/DD` stays month/day regardless of language
- Status text such as "进行中" is never taken over, and no row is inserted or hidden
